description: For finite propositional premises and a conclusion, semantic consequence holds if and only if every row on their combined finite atom support passes the truth-table criterion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.entails_iff_table.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails Γ A ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TableEntails Γ A
